hh_slot_summary.how_D11_decouples: graph by graph: D11 (scalar loop, conserved matter stress tensor) is transverse by itself, 4D and evanescent parts separately; its evanescent poles are nonzero but transverse. D13_summary.convention: G_{(mn) nu}(p) = V_Gamma1[K'_(mn)(-p), c^nu(p)] = kappa^2 * (i S_eps/(16 pi^2)) * Ghat, Ghat = sum A_i(d) T_i * MB, MB = Ihat(1,1) = 1/eps + 2 - L + O(eps), L = log(-p^2/mu^2 - i0); indices lower (K' slot dual to h_(mn), c^nu -> lower nu); p_r lower components; p^2 = eta^{rs} p_r p_s
D13_summary.MSbar_counterterm: delta S = - kappa^2 (i S_eps/(16 pi^2)) (1/eps) * sum_k z_k O_k  (O_k the p14r c.K' densities, z = UV_pole coordinates); plus, for the evanescent structures, an evanescent counterterm (Gt_mn p_nu p^2, (Gt p + Gt p) p^2) NOT in the p14r basis
D13_summary.local_ambiguity: finite renormalization along the three p14r c.K' directions: G^R -> G^R + kappa^2 (i/(16 pi^2)) sum_k f_k O_k; a change of scale mu -> mu' shifts the local polynomial by + A_i(4) log(mu'^2/mu^2) along the UV-pole direction
D13_summary.renormalization_conditions: MS-bar at mu: counterterm = pure pole (P14 normalization condition 0); no lower-degree K'.c contact (mu^2 K' dc) is generated (no scale but mu; pole is cubic in p); u^R_mu (XVI-O) not modified; an alternative momentum subtraction at p^2 = -M^2 differs by the finite renormalization A_i(4) log(M^2/mu^2) - (local MS-bar polynomial) along the same directions
